papers_found.title: Cross-sectional factor momentum: evidence from multiple formation periods
papers_found.relevance_reason: Directly extends H198 (confirmed 6-1m momentum). Multiple windows (1-1, 2-6, 7-12, 13-60m) blend outperforms single window. Actionable as H223.

papers_found.title: AlphaCrafter: A Full-Stack Multi-Agent Framework for Cross-Sectional Quantitative Trading
papers_found.relevance_reason: Three-agent system (Miner/Screener/Trader) for regime-conditioned factor ensemble. Directly applicable to blending our confirmed factors (BAB+MOM+QMJ+alpha101). Introduces H224 candidate.

papers_found.title: Enhancing Post Earnings Announcement Drift Measurement with Large Language Models
papers_found.relevance_reason: FinBERT 57.6-58.3% accuracy on PEAD direction; larger LLMs outperform. Directly upgrades H174 (confirmed). H225 candidate: GPT-4o-mini scoring of 8-K press releases.

papers_found.title: Toward Expert Investment Teams: A Multi-Agent LLM System with Fine-Grained Trading Tasks
papers_found.relevance_reason: Fine-grained task decomposition improves multi-agent LLM trading. Evaluates on Japanese stocks. Less directly actionable than AlphaCrafter — similar theme but different data and architecture.
papers_found.staged_reason: AlphaCrafter (2605.05580) is more directly applicable and was already staged. This paper is a supporting reference.

papers_found.title: When Agents Trade: Live Multi-Market Trading Benchmark for LLM Agents
papers_found.relevance_reason: LLM agents outperform buy-and-hold in live environments. Agent architecture matters more than LLM backbone. Confirms multi-agent direction. No specific actionable signal for our pipeline.
papers_found.staged_reason: No specific new signal; general confirmation of multi-agent direction already noted.

papers_found.title: Pairs Trading Using a Novel Graphical Matching Approach
papers_found.relevance_reason: Already noted in hypothesis log as H200 (NOT CONFIRMED). Pairs family is EXHAUSTED on our 30-stock universe. No new developments found.

papers_found.title: Spatio-Temporal Momentum: Jointly Learning Time-Series and Cross-Sectional Strategies
papers_found.relevance_reason: Interesting unification of TS and CS momentum but requires deep learning infrastructure. H180 (spatio-temporal NN) was already deprioritized due to implementation complexity.

papers_found.title: Parameters Optimization of Pair Trading Algorithm
papers_found.relevance_reason: Pairs trading parameter optimization. Pairs family exhausted.
